title: AWKUM Organizes Career Counseling Session for 2nd Year Students from Various Colleges of District Mardan
text:
The University
Advancement & Career Development Center (UA&CDC) at Abdul Wali Khan
University, Mardan, organized a Career Counseling and Orientation Session for
the intermediate 2nd-year students. Students from the Government Post Graduate
College Mardan, Nisar Shaheed School & College Risalpure, The Fazle Haq
College Mardan,
Government Degree College
Toru, Government
Girls Degree College Sheikh Maltoon, Government Degree College Lund Khwar, Government
Degree College No. 2 Mardan, and Government Degree College Takht Bhai, and P
eshawar Degree
College
Boys Mardan,

Speaking on the
occasion, Dr. Muhammad Bilal, Director UA&CDC, emphasized the importance of
making informed decisions regarding future education and career paths. He
encouraged students to select degree programs based on their interests,
abilities, and career aspirations rather than external pressures or prevailing
trends. He also highlighted the importance of self-assessment, exploring career
opportunities, and aligning academic choices with long-term professional goals.

Dr. Muhammad Amir,
Director of Admissions and Financial Aid, introduced the students to the
academic programs, facilities, and opportunities available at Abdul Wali Khan
University Mardan. He highlighted the University's quality education, modern
laboratories, research facilities, scholarships, internships, career counseling
services, industry linkages, and student support programs.

As part of the program,
the students visited various university facilities, including the Museum, Fish
Hatcheries, Central Library, and research laboratories, where they gained
firsthand exposure to the University's academic and research environment.

The session concluded
with an interactive discussion during which students asked questions about
higher education opportunities, admissions, and career pathways. The event
reflects UA&CDC’s commitment to guiding young learners and helping them
make informed decisions about their academic and professional futures.
